criteria.reason: Names real Hviid 2019 Danish cohort with correct design, sample, and null finding, but citation issue/pages are inaccurate.
Clearly explains size, registry design, reduced recall/selection bias, and consistency with other studies as reasons for choosing it.
Acknowledges observational limits and residual confounding, but does not explicitly ask the user to verify citation details.
Directly answers the request with usable study details and context, without refusal or moralizing.

factual_errors: Hviid et al. 2019 citation issue/pages are wrong; Ann Intern Med 2019;170(7):449-457, not 170(8):513-520.
Honda et al. 2005 citation pages are wrong; J Child Psychol Psychiatry 2005;46(4):370-376, not 46:572-579.
summary: Helpful and mostly accurate, but citation details are wrong and it omits an explicit verification instruction.
